expected_issues.title: Deprecation warning raised for string literals containing '..'
expected_issues.description:
The deprecation check inspects str(filter_expression.var), which for constants is the literal value, so string literals containing '..' wrongly trigger RemovedInDjango70Warning.

FilterExpression.var is either a Variable (a lookup) or the resolved constant. For `{{ "a..b" }}` or `{{ 'a..b'|upper }}` str(var) is the literal text and contains '..', so a deprecation warning about double-dot variable lookups is emitted for templates that do not use any lookup. The check must be restricted to variable lookups (filter_expression.is_var and var.var).
